en.headline: 12 own commits across two repositories
en.summary: **12 own commits** were recorded across `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` and `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit`, with no automated commits. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 10 commits revised agent and knowledge documentation: `AGENTS.md` was designated as the agreed single landing point, conversational self-reflection and first-person wording were removed, and LSP guidance was corrected to match the official migration guide, including the `experimental.todo` switch for `todowrite`. The documentation also added source evidence that the LSP runtime is unimplemented, clarified that `browser` is a namespace, rewrote the built-in tool list for V1/V2, and updated the directory index with criteria for `enhance-prompt`. Further commits added desktop harness inventories, OpenCode V2 comment and tool comparisons, review-tool lineage and in-session review prompts, three Windows Shell environment notes covering `PSReadLine`, `MINGW64`, and `WSL`, and ignored the `.workbuddy` project data directory. In `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit`, 2 commits upgraded the gallery into a GitHub Pages homepage with bilingual, light/dark, and copy-command features driven by Markdown, and added 12 Xiaohongshu-style covers plus a browsable gallery page. No pull requests, issues, reviews, releases, or discussions were recorded.

zh.headline: 两个仓库共完成 12 次本人提交
zh.summary: 当天在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 和 `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` 共完成 **12 次本人提交**，无自动提交。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 10 次提交集中修订代理与知识文档：将 `AGENTS.md` 明确为约定唯一落点，去除对话式自省和第一人称表述，并按官方迁移指南改正 LSP 口径，补充 `todowrite` 的 `experimental.todo` 开关。文档还补充了 LSP 运行时未实现的源码证据，说明 `browser` 是命名空间，按 V1/V2 双文档重写内置工具清单，并更新目录索引及 `enhance-prompt` 的形态判据。其余提交收录桌面 harness 清单、OpenCode V2 评论与工具对照、审查工具谱系与会话内审查提示词，以及涵盖 `PSReadLine`、`MINGW64`、`WSL` 的三篇 Windows Shell 环境文档，并将 `.workbuddy` 项目数据目录加入忽略列表。`sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` 的 2 次提交将画廊升级为 GitHub Pages 首页，提供双语、明暗主题和复制命令，内容改由 Markdown 驱动，同时新增 12 张小红书风格封面与可浏览画廊页面。当天没有 pull request、issue、review、release 或讨论记录。
